name: Global Net Lease (GNL)
teaser: At $7.31 the shares trade 15.9% above my Base value of $6.31, a downside of 13.7%. The 10.4% dividend is real income today, but after property reinvestment, stock pay and recurring costs the cash left per share is about $0.73 against a $0.76 payout, and it drifts lower in my Base as debt is refinanced at higher rates. Confidence is C and the required margin of safety is 40%, which puts the maximum buy price at $3.79. Reduce for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results on November 4 are not in this analysis.
llms: Global Net Lease (GNL), a net lease REIT with industrial, retail and office properties, is valued on AFFO after property reinvestment, stock pay and recurring costs with a 2031 exit, cross-checked with a property net asset value. Bear $1.85, Base $6.31, Bull $10.64. Verdict Reduce at $7.31, maximum buy price $3.79.
